752:t_2:121.en:
$$ルイス$$
「All we can do is pray from here!」

752:t_2:122.en:
$$恭子$$
「But we'll do everything we can!」

752:t_2:125.en:
$$風間$$
「Don't lose, $c! Don't lose, $$ボランティア部$$!!」

752:t_3:4.en:
$n
(I can't... see anything... I can't... hear anything...)

752:t_3:11.en:
$$桂$$
「...The multiverse... is being restored to its original worlds...」

752:t_3:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So it's returning to the worlds before the $$時空震動弾$$ activated... before the $$大時空震動$$...」

752:t_3:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And as spacetime is repaired, people are returning to their respective worlds...」

752:t_3:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「Are we all going to be separated!?」

752:t_3:17.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We have no choice if we're going to protect the universe...」

752:t_3:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's hold our heads high. It's not like our memories will disappear.」

752:t_3:19.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right! I'll never forget the days we fought as $c!」

752:t_3:20.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We couldn't forget even if we tried!」

752:t_3:23.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's how we lived life to the fullest.」

752:t_3:24.en:
$$刹那$$
「Those days will stay with us as memories.」

752:t_3:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Someday humanity will be able to control even spacetime. We've reached the threshold of evolution, after all.」

752:t_3:29.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Can we... really do something like that...?」

752:t_3:30.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm sure we can someday. That's our potential.」

752:t_3:31.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What will make it happen is...!」

752:t_3:33.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's do it! Today is another new beginning!」

752:t_3:34.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We'll each do our best to live in our own newly born worlds...」

752:t_3:36.en:
$$アルト$$
「So it's just a little goodbye until then.」

752:t_3:38.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If we set our hearts on fire, spacetime doesn't matter!」

752:t_3:39.en:
$$レド$$
「That's right. No matter how far apart we are, our feelings are one.」

752:t_3:40.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「$c disbands today. But its existence is eternal.」

752:t_3:41.en:
$$葵$$
「Our feelings are eternal... Maybe that's where our $$シンカ$$ is headed.」

752:t_3:42.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Maybe so. But this feels pretty good.」

752:t_3:43.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've... been fighting for this very moment.」

752:t_3:45.en:
$$桂$$
「It's a battle to keep living...! That is our battle in the new worlds!」

752:t_3:50.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You lent us your strength too.」

752:t_3:51.en:
$$ユーサー$$
「It seems part of our souls was left behind in each $$スフィア$$.」

752:t_3:52.en:
$$アイム#pilot$$
「The power of life delivered from Earth seems to have awakened them.」

752:t_3:54.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「There's no need to be sad, $$セツコ$$.」

752:t_3:55.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The Supreme God has vanished, and the $$スフィア$$s will disappear too...」

752:t_3:56.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Now our souls, trapped between the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist, will be freed too.」

752:t_3:57.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「We have no regrets. We lived to the fullest, and the universe was saved.」

752:t_3:61.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Let's celebrate our reunion then.」

752:t_3:62.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hearing you people say that somehow makes me nervous...」

752:t_3:63.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But I think that's still a long, long way off.」

752:t_3:65.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As long as that light lasts, live with all your strength.」

752:t_3:66.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You don't have to tell us.」

752:t_3:67.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Thank you. Now I can ride a new wind...」

752:t_3:68.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Yes... The wind is calling... That voice... I heard once before...」

752:t_3:71.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It seems he's got some business of his own.」

752:t_3:72.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then tell him too. Tell him to live strongly.」

752:t_3:82.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll carry the last remaining force that seeks to vanish beyond the causal horizon.」

752:t_3:84.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's all right. I've had more than enough fun already.」

752:t_3:85.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Besides, now that the multiverse is ending, my interest and my role have both run their course.」
